status_of_seasons.current_already_looked_at: 2026/27 up to the data snapshot below (NOT a holdout)

selection_by_frozen_rule.rule: Среди правил, отличных от текущего (12 правил каталога), на 2023/24 и 2024/25: доля ставок с ценой ≥ 85 % и средний коэффициент ≥ 2.80 в обоих сезонах; выбирается правило с наибольшим min(ROI 2023/24, ROI 2024/25). Перспективно, если ΔROI к текущему > 0 в обоих сезонах и Holm-p объединённого теста < 0.05.
selection_by_frozen_rule.chosen: v6.1: стек с рынком, пол EV ≥ 0

H1_rule.name: v6.1: стек с рынком, пол EV ≥ 0
H1_rule.rule: Production Risk pool and score (src/markets/recommendation.risk_prediction) unchanged, with one extra first tier: among pool candidates with a real price whose EV at the stacked probability p_s >= 0, the best production score computed with p_s; otherwise the production Risk. p_s = sigmoid(b1_k logit(pc) + b2_k logit(qc) + b0_k) (1 - p_refund), pc = p / (1 - p_refund), qc = proportional de-vigged price of a full book (Asian whole line: P(win | no refund)); coefficients per selection key k (pooled key '*' below 300 rows) fitted by logistic regression (C = 1e4) on the decided pool rows of 2022/23-2025/26 walk-forward predictions — the 2026/27 fit of experiments/v6_2/risk (frozen numbers below).
H1_rule.forward_criterion: On Risk bets of matches played after the commit of this file, the paired bootstrap 95 % CI (by match, 2000 resamples, seed 20261109) of ROI(H1) - ROI(production Risk) lies above 0, evaluated once at >= 2000 settled matches with both picks priced (or at the end of season 2026/27 if fewer: then the result is reported as inconclusive unless the CI is above 0).
H1_rule.decision: B now. A only if the forward criterion holds; the rule still loses money in every season (it reduces the loss), so adoption would change WHICH Risk is shown, not make Risk a bet.

H2_display.name: Вероятность Risk = вероятность рынка без маржи
H2_display.rule: For the shown Risk with a full real book, the stated probability is the proportional de-vigged market probability of a win (Asian whole line: P(win | no refund) on the decided scale); the pick is unchanged.
H2_display.forward_criterion: On the shown Risk of matches played after the commit (decided, full book), the 95 % bootstrap CI of mean(stated) - hit rate contains 0 AND the paired CI of |gap(market)| - |gap(model)| lies below 0; evaluated at >= 1000 settled Risk picks.
H2_display.decision: B now; A (display only) if the forward criterion holds.

multiplicity: Two forward hypotheses; Holm correction over H1 and H2.
